content: {"episode_id":"ep-05055","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"I request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), for which prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents a history of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias. The mobile cardiac telemetry study was ordered to accurately capture the frequency and duration of these episodic symptoms for appropriate management."}
